$comment: The screenshots the site shows, in images/shots/<id>.webp: WittyMediaServer 0.8 in the Lumen layout and Witty colours, on a test server filled only with the openly licensed media in WittyDemoMedia. Every work each one shows is recorded in content/licences.json under shots/<id>. UPDATING.md says how to take them again.
